Subject: The Stormline Shell is back in stock
Preview: It sold out fast last time. Here it is again — same jacket, ready to ship.
Body: If you missed it before, the Northbay Stormline Shell (NB-JKT-07) is back in stock.

When you're three days into a wet ridge traverse and the weather hasn't cooperated once, you want a shell that stays functional — not one that soaks through by afternoon.

The Stormline is built for sustained wet weather. Here's what that means in numbers:

• 20,000mm waterproof rating — keeps rain out under real, prolonged precipitation
• 20,000 g/m² breathability — moves moisture out so you're not soaked from the inside
• 3-layer laminate construction — the face fabric, membrane, and liner are bonded together, which holds up better over time than a drop-liner design
• 420 grams — light enough to carry without thinking about it, substantial enough to be your primary rain layer

A note on limits: this is a shell, not an insulated jacket. It won't keep you warm on its own in cold conditions — layer accordingly. It's also built for trail and alpine use, not technical climbing where a more specialized fit is needed.

It moved quickly last time. If you need a dependable rain shell for your next trip, now's the moment.
